name: Superman Hold

instructions.description: Lie face down on a mat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Gently brace the abdomen to avoid excessive compression in the lower back.
Lift the arms, chest, and legs slightly off the floor as tolerated while keeping the neck long.
Lower slowly back to the mat and rest before repeating.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short holds with controlled height rather than maximal lifting.

variations.variationDescription: Another posterior-chain trunk exercise, but performed prone instead of quadruped.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Lift one arm and the opposite leg at a time to reduce demand.

commentsNotes: Lift only high enough to maintain comfort.
